[P2] Preserve the guard against constructing an unused Lambda transport

This assertion duplicates the preceding `toBe(injected)` check and passes if initialization constructs and discards a `DurableExecutionApiClient` before returning the supplied client. That constructor immediately calls `loadLambdaModule()`, so removing the constructor assertions loses coverage that custom transports avoid loading the AWS SDK. The caching tests do not exercise execution-context transport selection. Retain a focused test that observes constructor or loader calls for both configuration-supplied and event-injected transports; it can live separately from these real-module tests.
